notes.title: A New Update
notes.notes:
Been a while, hasn't it, old friend.

I added a couple of cool things, more skins to unlock in the daily challenge mode, oh and a skin manager so you can choose your skins too.

I added Spanish to localization which is pretty neat, but generally lots of little bugfixes. let me know if I've broke anything!

Sorry it's taken so long. I've been making my new game Photographs, Its very different to my usual stuff in some ways, but very similar in others. Take a look and add it to your wishlist if you like what you see

 [url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1008920/Photographs/[/url]
